_doc: Generated per client during brief ingestion. Each entry: { id, status, builders, nota, source, acceptance }. This is the light lane of spec-driven design (SDD) — see AGENTS.md § Spec-first and specs/README.md.
_status: pending | in_progress | done — only ONE feature may be in_progress at a time. A feature cannot move to in_progress without both source and acceptance filled in.
_builders: subset of [front-end-astro, seo-guide-lines]. Sections -> front-end-astro; close each page with seo-guide-lines.
_source: REQUIRED. The brief section (or other approved document) this feature's content comes from, e.g. "arquitectura-informacion.md §2.1". No document → this isn't light-lane work, write a full spec with /spec instead.
_acceptance: REQUIRED. Boolean checklist derived from _source plus any CHECKPOINTS.md items that apply, e.g. ["h1 matches the copy in §2.1", "CTA links to /contacto"]. Verified for real by spec-verifier, same as a spec's Acceptance criteria.

features.source: textos-sitio.md §1 Inicio › Bloque: Servicios + arquitectura-informacion.md §3 (tarjetas con ancla propia)
acceptance: Section is src/components/perpage/home/Servicios.astro, rendered on / after CalmaActiva, with id='servicios' and aria-labelledby pointing at the h2
h2 'Tratamientos pensados para tu salud y tu confianza' with the two-weight treatment and a turquoise full stop. The reference's eyebrow and intro paragraph are not built
Desktop (lg+) is two columns: the left has the h2 and a list of the 2 services titles as tabs, active one in dark text with a bottom rule, inactive one light grey

The tab list is an ARIA tablist: role=tab/tabpanel, aria-selected, aria-controls, roving tabindex and arrow-key/Home/End navigation. A service is selected on mouse hover, click or keyboard. The first tab is selected by default. Without JS the first panel is visible

The right column shows the active service's detail: image area, h3 title, the approved text, and two buttons. Both panels render from services, not hardcoded. Blanqueamiento uses 'Una sonrisa más blanca, sin ansiedad ni sorpresas. Uno de nuestros tratamientos más solicitados.'; Rehabilitación uses 'La especialidad de la Dra. Viviana: recuperar función y estética a la vez, con un enfoque cálido.'

Primary button 'Ver el servicio' (with the small arrow-up-right icon) links to /blanqueamiento-dental/ or /rehabilitacion-oral/. Outline button 'Agendar por WhatsApp' links to COMPANY_INFO.whatsapp. No other CTA is invented

The image area renders <Image> from service.image (imported in src/config/services.ts). When an entry has no image it renders a brand-token placeholder (turquoise gradient with a tooth-outline watermark). No stock or invented photo
On mobile the tabs become a horizontal list above a single panel, and the layout is single-column

'También ofrecemos' renders the 8 serviceCards in brief order as tall rounded cards. Each has its anchor id (e.g. id='implantes') on the first copy only, a circular icon badge top-left from @/assets/icons/, and the title only (no description) at the bottom over a dark brand-token overlay. The card shows <Image> from serviceCard.image, or a placeholder background when absent

The cards run in an infinite GSAP marquee (src/components/ui/utils/Marquee.astro), paused on hover and focus. The clones are aria-hidden, inert and have no ids. With reduced motion or without JS nothing moves and the row is a keyboard-focusable, labelled, horizontally scrollable region
The reference's eyebrow, left intro paragraph and 'Book Appointment' wording are not copied. Only brief copy appears
Icons are imported from @/assets/icons/, aria-hidden, with no inline . No inline style="" and no arbitrary Tailwind values, brand tokens only

GSAP lives in src/utils/scripts/animations/: home/servicios.ts (reveal), home/servicios-tabs.ts (service switch) and utils/marquee.ts (marquee loop), each with a gsap.matchMedia() reduced-motion branch that lands everything visible (autoAlpha: 1) and never loops or hides content for those users. The headings and the marquee row fade in from the bottom via ScrollTrigger.batch, once. The service switch fades the current panel out and staggers the next one in
